paragraphs.notes: Body of claim 6, whose preamble ('6.  Benzoylcyclohexandione nach einem der Ansprueche 1 bis 5, worin') is the last line of the preceding page. All R symbols are printed with superscript digits; transcribed inline. 'Aikoxycarbonyl' is transcribed as printed: at high magnification the second character carries a clear dot, unlike the undotted l of 'Alkylcarbonyl' and 'Cycloalkylcarbonyl' earlier on the same line, so the page really does read Aikoxycarbonyl. It is almost certainly a defect for 'Alkoxycarbonyl' (compare 'Alkoxycarbonyloxy' and 'Alkoxycarbonylamino' two lines below, both undotted), but the misprint is left uncorrected per the verbatim rule and the English mirrors it. The list ends with a comma and no verb; it runs on into the R5 entry below. A small stray ink mark sits above the line near 'Alkenyl,' on the first line; it is a scan artifact, not a character. A second speck sits to the left of 'WO' in the header.
Printed with no closing punctuation, unlike every other entry on the page. Preserved as printed.
The 12 of OR12 is a superscript; the 1 and 6 of C1-C6 are subscripts. Both transcribed inline.
